obligations.why: Every PR passes the checks AGENTS.md lists before a PR, with no test skipped that is not allowed to skip

A feature or fix merges only after an agent that did not write it has used it on the box as a signed-in person, and put the verdict on the PR (AGENTS.md, Check Features on the Box). Test, CI and docs PRs owe none

owes.what: another agent uses the change on the box, on a build that contains this PR, and posts the verdict on the PR
owes.how: AGENTS.md, Check Features on the Box; the verify skill's box check

obligations.why: A change a person can see (a screen, a dialog, copy, styling, a CLI's output) carries screenshots of every state it touches, with main beside it when it alters an existing screen

owes.what: a screenshot of every state the change touches, before and after
owes.how: the verify skill's drivers for web, TUI, desktop, mobile-web and VS Code

obligations.why: The standby discard model stands for this code: a discard never reaches a workspace a session holds or can still take

owes.how: .agents/skills/standby-discard: decide whether the change touches the model, run it, keep it true to the code

obligations.why: First server setup on a real Docker engine: volume ownership and the official Postgres bootstrap. CI does not run these; they skip unless given a disposable Docker context
Preview cookies, cross-preview isolation and stream buffering are only exercised by the preview acceptance suite (real browser, Caddy, gateway), which CI does not run
A CLI tarball can install and still fail to start; only the installed-CLI smoke sees it

ciLanes.command: the packaging job's node --test list in .github/workflows/ci.yml (needs Docker, Helm, OpenTofu and Chromium)
